decisions.reason: Authorization to publish one currently approved clip does not change the requirement to produce 100 client-approved clips per month or its counting rule.
The one-clip publication authorization does not change the Lead Clipper pathway, assignment, training, or responsibilities.
The source concerns publication of an approved clip, not the separate one-clip corrective qualification task or its success condition.
Allowing one approved clip to be posted is consistent with the existing rule that only approved clips are publication-eligible and does not alter the approval authority or gate.
The publication-count decision does not change any clip-duration or minimum approval-duration constraint.
The source authorizes publication quantity but does not change permitted source material or video-selection constraints.
The authorization to post one clip does not modify the requirement that each clip contain a complete standalone lesson, story, or point.
The source does not change caption color, font, effects, lettering style, or position.
The one-clip publication authorization leaves the clean editing, effects, and transition standards unchanged.
The source contains no decision about wind-noise removal or other audio cleanup.
Authorization to publish one clip does not change the Google Drive review submission workflow or the planned Notion submission channel.
The source does not alter the requirement to select strong and impactful source moments.
